clue.text: Little time in starting to choose players for ground-breaking performance

indicators.note: the word 'in' tells us the other pieces sit inside the word for starting

parts.note: a starting or beginning is an opening
to choose the players for a show is to cast it
min is the short form of minute, a little time

explanation.surface: A tiny pause before picking the cast for a pioneering show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground-breaking' sounds like praise for originality, but here it is literal: mining that digs open the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Surface mining literally breaks ground, so a cryptic reading calls it a ground-breaking operation or performance.

clue.text: Expression of Act of Uniformity?

parts.note: the Act of Uniformity was a law imposing one form of worship; a phrase that captures uniformity is the shop-label saying that one garment suits everyone

explanation.definitionFit: The stock phrase describes a single standard applied to everybody, which is exactly what uniformity means.

clue.text: Try to beat bird out of office

parts.note: the emu is a large flightless Australian bird
someone late in a job is a former holder, now out of office

explanation.surface: A bird attempting to defeat a former official.
explanation.definitionFit: To emulate someone is to try to equal or surpass them, a rivalrous attempt to beat them.

clue.text: Happy with what's in the paper and who controls it?

parts.note: the material printed in a newspaper is its content
the editor, abbreviated ED, is in charge of a newspaper

explanation.surface: A question about whether one is pleased with a newspaper's coverage and its owner.
explanation.definitionFit: Contented is a synonym of happy, describing someone satisfied with their lot.

clue.text: Italian city of New Orleans

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made over into a fresh order

explanation.surface: An Italian city said to belong to New Orleans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New Orleans' reads as one American place name, but 'New' is the signal to rearrange ORLEANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Salerno is a port city in Campania, southern Italy.

clue.text: Illusions when space station gets past its prime

parts.note: Mir was the Soviet and Russian space station
something that ages grows old and passes its best

explanation.surface: Illusions that appear when an orbiting station grows old.
explanation.definitionFit: Mirages are optical illusions, such as water seen shimmering in a desert.

clue.text: Saw retreating group

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the letters of the saw's name are read in reverse

parts.note: a tenon saw is a small woodworking saw

explanation.surface: A saw seen pulling back from a group of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past tense of see; it is a tenon saw, a carpenter's tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine musicians, or a piece written for them.

clue.text: Scientist keeping 3rd law — Telford perhaps?

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: Isaac Newton, the physicist famous for his laws of motion

indicators.note: 3rd points to the third letter of the word law

explanation.surface: A scientist abiding by his third law of motion, apparently in Shropshire.
explanation.walkthrough: '3rd law' suggests Newton's third law of motion, but it simply means the third letter of 'law'. Telford is a planned town in Shropshire, England, built from the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: Telford is one of Britain's postwar planned settlements, an example of the category; hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: With credit card escalation happening, one can afford a facelift

parts.note: plastic is informal for credit cards collectively
a surge is a sudden rise or escalation
something on is taking place or happening

explanation.surface: Someone running up a big credit card bill can pay for cosmetic surgery.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a wealthy patient; it is the doctor who performs the work, and 'afford' means provide.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosmetic surgeon provides, or affords, facelifts to patients; afford here means to give or supply.

clue.text: Twice-yearly event with no beef — instead a line of horses

indicators.note: instead says one piece replaces another within the longer word

parts.note: the equinox, when day and night are equal, happens in March and September
an ox is a beef animal

explanation.surface: A biannual event goes meat-free and offers a row of horses in its place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no beef' takes OX out of EQUINOX, and 'instead' puts A and L in its place.
explanation.definitionFit: Equinal is an adjective meaning relating to horses, a rarer variant of equine.

clue.text: Refreshment for Frenchman rejecting rule

parts.note: Rene is a common French man's name

indicators.note: rejecting means turning back, so the word for rule is read backwards

parts.note: a law is a rule

explanation.surface: A Frenchman turns his back on regulations and seeks refreshment.
explanation.definitionFit: Renewal means being refreshed or revived, made new again.

clue.text: Periodical that's about presenting an idol

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps around the other

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
a mag, short for magazine, is a periodical

explanation.surface: A magazine article that presents a hero to its readers.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol in the old sense is a carved likeness or graven figure worshipped as a god.

clue.text: Hit grouse flying — nothing wrong there

indicators.note: flying suggests the letters scatter and settle in a new order

explanation.surface: A shooting party downs a grouse in flight, and nobody thinks it wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying' looks like the grouse's motion but signals an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone righteous is morally upright, with no wrongdoing in them, so there is nothing wrong there.

clue.text: Democratic gestures to silence unrest?

indicators.note: unrest means disturbance, so the letters are stirred into another order

explanation.surface: A suggestion that holding polls might quieten civil disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unrest' seems part of the political picture but signals rearranging TO SILENCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Polls in which citizens vote are the characteristic acts or gestures of democracy.

clue.text: Low-down side given spirits

parts.note: gen is slang for information, the low-down
a cricket or football side is eleven players, written II in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Inside information supplied to a team about spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: Eleven is XI in Roman numerals, but the setter uses II, the two ones of 11; the low-down is information, not something low.
explanation.definitionFit: Genii is a plural of genie, the spirits of Arabian folklore.

clue.text: The Italian regular struggling to become irregular

indicators.note: struggling suggests the letters are thrashing about into a new order

parts.note: il is the Italian word for the

explanation.surface: An Italian regular soldier strives to become irregular.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irregular' is a noun here: an irregular soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: A guerrilla is an irregular, a fighter outside a regular army.

clue.text: Some climbed steps to get into 16 part 2

indicators.note: some of means only part of the following word is used

explanation.surface: Climbing some stairs to reach the top bunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 16 is BUNKBED, whose second part is BED; 'steps to' joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbed, a variant of embed, is to set firmly into something, here into a bed.

clue.text: Where the rest can be taken on board

definitions.text: Where the rest can be taken on board

parts.words: Where the rest can be taken on board
parts.note: rest is sleep rather than the remainder, and the board is a wooden frame stacked above another

explanation.definitionFit: Stacked sleeping frames let people rest, often on a board base, a playful view of a bed.

clue.text: Ranches losing head need aid to rebuild them

definitions.text: Ranches losing head need aid to rebuild them

indicators.note: to rebuild means the pieces are reassembled in a different order
losing head removes the first letter of the word ranches

explanation.surface: Ranches whose boss has gone need help to be restored.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing head' leaves ANCHES; 'to rebuild' shuffles it with AID. The whole clue also defines Spanish-style ranches.
explanation.definitionFit: Haciendas are large estates or ranches in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: To treat dry heat, soak

indicators.note: to treat means to process, so the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice that the remedy for dry heat is to soak.
explanation.definitionFit: To hydrate is to supply with water or let something absorb it, which is to soak it.

clue.text: Company turn over a joint of venison

indicators.note: over means covering, so one piece is placed around the other

parts.note: a rib is a cut or joint of meat
a U-turn, so U stands for turn

explanation.surface: A firm turns over a joint of deer meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn over' reads as one verb, but 'turn' gives U and 'over' sets the company-plus-U around A RIB.
explanation.definitionFit: The caribou is a North American reindeer, a deer whose meat is a source of venison.

clue.text: Brown's profitable code?

parts.note: Dan Brown's bestselling thriller about a code named for a Renaissance artist earned him a fortune

explanation.definitionFit: Dan Brown's novel The Da Vinci Code made huge sums, so the artist's name is his profitable code.

clue.text: Bank on Father Christmas reflecting red nose, for a start

parts.note: Santa is another name for Father Christmas

indicators.note: for a start means only the opening letter of the word nose
reflecting means mirrored, so the word red reads backwards

explanation.surface: A bank relying on Father Christmas whose red nose shines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank on' reads as a phrase meaning rely on; 'Bank' is the definition and 'on' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Santander is a major Spanish banking group with many UK branches.

clue.text: Five leading parliamentarians go off for a month

indicators.note: go off suggests the letters explode into a new order
five leading means the first five letters of the next word

explanation.surface: Five senior MPs leave for a month's holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Five leading' takes PARLI, the start of 'parliamentarians', and 'go off' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: April is the fourth month of the year.

clue.text: Plate or Main course?

parts.note: the Plate in South America and the Main in Germany are both watercourses, not dishes

explanation.definitionFit: A watercourse is a flowing stream, and the Plate and the Main are famous examples.

clue.text: Country with party one may get in time

parts.note: Lib is short for the Liberal party

indicators.note: get in means one piece enters the other

parts.note: an era is a period of time
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A nation where a political party may be elected in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberia is a West African nation founded by freed American slaves.

clue.text: Scale of what 20 may hold

definitions.meaning: 20 is SANTANDER, a bank, which holds the sum in an account

explanation.definitionFit: A balance is a weighing scale, and also the money remaining in a bank account.

clue.text: Excessive praise about Edward at university starting course for mature students

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the praise wraps around the other pieces

parts.note: adulation is excessive flattery or praise
Ted is a short form of Edward

indicators.note: starting means the first letter of the word course

explanation.surface: Fawning over Edward at college while starting a course for older learners.
explanation.definitionFit: Classes for grown-ups, often evening classes, are known in Britain as this kind of education.
